notAccessGroup.title: A team has access only where it was granted
notAccessGroup.description: Putting somebody on a team says who they work with, and on its own it opens nothing. A project, or the whole organization, opens to a team only when access is granted to that team, and then to everybody on it. There is no screen for granting it yet: that is done through the API.

field.name: Name
field.slugHint: Lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens — this is how the team appears in a link.
field.slugInvalid: Only lower-case Latin letters, digits and single hyphens

empty.title: No teams here
empty.description: Create a team and the people who work together will be in one place.
empty.filtered: No team matches this search. Try a shorter phrase.

list.failed: The teams could not be loaded.

detail.title: Team
detail.failed: This team could not be loaded.

create.title: New team
create.description: A name people recognise and an address for links. You can change both later.

edit.title: Name and address
edit.description: The whole team is saved, so a description left empty is cleared.

members.title: Who is on the team
members.description: A lead is a member marked as one — there is no separate field for it.

add.roleHint: Choose «Lead» to make this person the team's lead.
add.none: Everybody in the directory is already on this team.

danger.title: Disbanding
danger.description: This cannot be undone from the interface.

delete.title: Disband the team?
delete.description: «{{name}}» will stop existing as a team.

consequence.members: Everybody is taken off the team, in one go.
consequence.access: Access granted to the team is withdrawn: its members lose whatever they had only through the team.
consequence.slug: The address is freed and can be used by a new team.
